svg.desc: Placeholder explaining that dating supplier exits requires the cohort source to be active.
svg.text: Q14 — do suppliers leave before a shortage, or after it?
274 cohort molecules have a baseline, from 1 day(s) of capture. A level, not yet a trend.
Drugs@FDA gives each product's CURRENT marketing status and no discontinuation date — not in the API, and not in FDA's own bulk file.
Sampling it monthly is what turns an exit into a dated event. Nothing published can backfill it.
The source is written and paused; flipping status: active starts the series.
Q13 shows how far attrition has already gone. This one asks when it happened, and only capture answers that.
